images.name: foyer
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a single 1536x1024 landscape GAMEPLAY ROOM VIEW for a Minecraft Halloween adventure. The five supplied images are user art-direction references; use their BLOCK-BUILT MINECRAFT STRUCTURES and HALLOWEEN ENVIRONMENTAL DECORATION, not any captions or watermarks. This must resemble a restrained screenshot from a playable vanilla Minecraft haunted build, with simple 16x16 nearest-neighbor material textures and clearly visible cube-grid construction. NOT a painted pixel illustration. NOT a warm fantasy illustration. Reduce saturation and lighting substantially from a typical AI-generated cozy room.
Room: entrance hall of a modest haunted cottage/manor. Actual grid-built dark spruce staircase along the RIGHT leads to a shut oak attic door. LEFT doorway opens into a small study. Foreground floor is large, flat, simple grey stone-brick tiles. Dark spruce plank walls, pale grey stone foundation; a little ripped black-and-orange cloth banner, two sparse cobwebs, ONE jack-o-lantern at the foot of the stairs and ONE small wall lantern. One black Minecraft block cat sits near bottom right. A small simple cream cuboid friendly ghost floats by the staircase, square dark eyes, discreet, NOT a cute cartoon cloth rendering. Preserve navigable clear space; ordinary rectangular room with honest straight plank edges and right angles. Limited purposeful props. NO jungle vines coating everything, no ornate brass, no piles of books and candles, no giant chandelier.
Lighting: very dim cool blue-grey night ambient, desaturated brown wood, medium-dark readable grey stone. Only the cut-out pumpkin eyes and the small lantern flame emit restrained amber; they must NOT wash the whole room orange. No bloom, no radiant halos, no god rays, no gloss, no depth of field. Matte plain Minecraft textures. Use dark moss green sparingly. Comfortable spooky Halloween mood, not pitch black. Camera at standing player height, 65-degree FOV. No HUD, no crosshair, no text, no borders, no watermark. A coherent in-engine voxel screenshot rather than an art poster.
